messages:
liz: Quick heads-up — draft release notes for tomorrow's microrelease are in the doc. Can folks eyeball? Need to lock the runtime pin and quiet window by EOD.

michael: on it, linking the doc. main ask: confirm we pin inference runtime to v2.11.4 for the canary.

samir: +1 on pin. v2.11.4 avoids the kv-cache regression we saw on long contexts.

elaine: RN request: add explicit rollback criteria per ops: latency > 2x baseline OR error rate > 1.5% for 5m. Also include who calls the rollback and the comms channel.

liz: added thresholds and owner list. Put the rollback command (`rb rollback --tag=release-20240215`) and a short step-by-step.

deploybot: Deployment scheduled by @liz for 2024-02-15 22:00 UTC. Canary: 10% (region: us-west1). Command: `rb deploy --env=staging --tag=release-20240215 --canary=10`

ops-oncall: Quiet window requested 21:30-23:30 UTC. I'll be on standby. If latency crosses threshold, we abort canary and roll back immediately.

michael: are we shipping the telemetry tweak that alters token accounting? Need a note so Finance doesn't get spooked.

liz: yes, shipping telemetry tweak. Added bullet: "Telemetry: fine-grained token logging enabled — expect a small transient billing variance in first 24h."

samir: add canary checklist to RN: healthchecks, p95 probe, token-rate sanity, endpoint error spike watch, and a fail-open fallback to model-variant.

liz: checklist added. Included exact probe queries and the synthetic traffic curl snippet.

elaine: suggestion: rehearse rollback at 22:05 with a simulated fail (5m smoke) before ramp. If rehearsal fails, we keep at 10% and investigate.

ops-oncall: agree. I'll trigger a 2-step smoke at 22:05 and report status in this thread.

michael: wording nit for internal announce: change "billing variance" -> "small transient billing variance" — less alarming.

liz: updated. Planning to post internal announcement at 18:00 so PMs/product have time to prep external comms.

samir: approved.

elaine: approved, left one grammar tweak.

ops-oncall: approved. Quiet window and standby confirmed.

deploybot: Reminder: to abort deploy before canary starts run `rb cancel --tag=release-20240215`

liz: thanks — will post internal RN at 18:00 and pin. Doc link: https://redwood.example/docs/rn/2024-02-15-microrelease (internal) :thumbsup:

michael: :rocket: good luck. I'll watch the p95 dashboards.

samir: will monitor KV hit-rate and token-rate; ping me for anomalies.

ops-oncall: if we rollback, I'll coordinate the quick postmortem and tag owners. Also added a tiny postmortem template in RN for fast capture.

liz: captured the PM template and the short comms snippet for customers if we need to communicate a rollback.

michael: all set here. Pin locked and quiet window scheduled.

liz: closing thread — will reopen if any last-minute edits.
